method: Built-in image_gen for three AI textures; procedural SVG radial gradient rasterized with sharp for the comparison.

prompts.sun: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated illumination texture for compositing BEHIND a miniature star on a flat purple museum-display wall. Render ONLY the light falling onto the wall, front-on, centered on a square canvas, genuinely transparent background. No star, no sphere, no physical object, no flame, no wall surface, no floor, no shadow, no text. This is very faint candle-level reflected illumination, not a blazing astronomical corona or lens flare. A soft central pool fading gradually outward, with a few unequal, broad, very soft radial lobes/rays of different lengths and intensities, irregular but restrained. No hard rays, no symmetrical starburst, no crisp outline, no sparks, no rings. All light fades fully to transparent well before image edges with ample margins. Low-opacity colored light with smooth gradients; no solid white center. Intended to be shown at only about 20% screen blend opacity on deep violet #392885. Palette: pale candle-gold and soft warm cream. Gentle honey warmth. Moderate asymmetry in the faint diffuse rays.
